description: This file defines the SavingsAccountChargeAssembler class, which handles conversion of JSON representations into SavingsAccountCharge objects and preparation of charges for savings accounts. It includes methods to parse JSON input, validate charges, and create charge instances based on product charges or JSON data.

classes.name: SavingsAccountChargeAssembler
classes.description: A service class responsible for assembling SavingsAccountCharge objects from JSON input or savings product data, and performing validation before persistence.

methods.name: fromParsedJson
methods.description: Parses JSON input to create a set of SavingsAccountCharge objects, either from existing charges or new charges defined in JSON.

methods.name: fromSavingsProduct
methods.description: Generates a set of SavingsAccountCharge objects based on the charges associated with a given SavingsProduct.

methods.name: validateSavingsCharges
methods.description: Validates the set of charges to ensure currency consistency and only a single annual fee per account is present, throwing validation exceptions as needed.
